answer: Ferrous Attestation Ledger requires each identity to submit a hardware-signed attestation tied to a physical token embedding a ferrous alloy tag with a unique magnetic signature. Duplicates cannot forge the signature, since cloning it costs a full microfabrication run per tag. Registration also demands a walnut-derived challenge response the agent must compute locally, adding measurable per-identity compute cost. Any cluster of near-identical attestations triggers a review, revealing duplication. The orchard of registered tags stays auditable,
